citations.quote:
[name="魏彦吾"]之前是信使，今天是太傅亲自到这来……  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]是有必须要和魏公说清的事。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#2", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]晖洁，回避。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]不必。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]一会要说的事，她最好也留下来听听。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……  
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#12$2")]
[name="陈"]……  
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#12$2")]
[name="陈"]好。  
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="l")]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l",isblock=true)]
[name="魏彦吾"]如今百灶城中境况……  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]中秋后，陛下特准他进入岁陵，尝试平息岁兽之患。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]可望日临近，岁陵中依然没有动静。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]而此时此刻，大炎周遭还有五只巨兽盘踞，不知祂们意欲何为。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]天机阁的天师，还有大炎最精锐的战士已经前往巨兽所在的各地，大炎并不惮于这一战。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]但最坏的结果，不只是与五只巨兽同时开战。  
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#11$2")]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#10$2")]
[name="陈"]竟然……  
[dialog]
[avgdisplay(id = "1", style = "bg", name = "bg_black",afrom=0,ato=0.6,duration=2,slot = "bgover", layer = 1,isblock=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot = "m", focus="n")]
[name="模糊的声音？"]“不知意欲何为”——这白胡子老头倒是会说话。
[name="模糊的声音？"]上千年的血仇，这时候找上门，还能是来串门送礼的不成？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#1$2",focus="m")]
[name="陈"]嗯……？  
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#12$2")]
[name="陈"]你……说什么？  
[dialog]
[avgdisplay(id = "1",style = "bg",name = "bg_black",afrom=0.6,ato=0,duration=1,slot = "bgover", layer = 1,block=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[avgdisplay(id = "1")]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="l")]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#2", focus="l",isblock=true)]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l",isblock=true)]
[name="魏彦吾"]……  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]这时候，应当已经有不少人力主开战了。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]此刻重要的不再是某一派的意见。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]只怕大炎已经没有选择。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]朝廷应当对此有过无数种预案。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]在无数种预案中，也不存在一种惨胜之外的结果。 
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#2$1", focus="r")] 
[name="太傅"]但依然还有我们不曾考虑过的手段。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#2", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……！  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#2", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]太傅，告诉我，胞弟不曾想过要自己去开启“不反”——
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]他是真龙，大炎的真龙。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]如若大炎真到了不得已的时候，也只有他能行此事。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#4", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……简直荒唐！  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]魏公。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]事已至此，我们不必再顾左右而言他。 
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")] 
[name="太傅"]那封送到龙门的密信，在禁军动身前还无人知晓。而我今天来见魏公，却不曾掩人耳目。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]魏公应当明白。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#4", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#4", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]这些旧事……四十年的旧事，上千年的旧事……绝对不该以这种方式收场。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#4", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……绝对不该，是由他去付出这个代价。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]无人愿意见到那个最坏的局面，但绝不可自欺欺人。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]我有必要提醒魏公——哪怕只是为大炎计，为天下计。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]当留后手。  
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#11$2")]
[name="陈"]请等一下。  
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#11$2")]
[name="陈"]我不明白，太傅说的“后手”是什么意思？  
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#1$2")]
[name="陈"]您刚刚说的这些事，和魏彦吾……有什么关系？  
[dialog]
[avgdisplay(id = "1", style = "bg", name = "bg_black",afrom=0,ato=0.6,duration=2,slot = "bgover", layer = 1,isblock=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot = "m", focus="n")]
[name="模糊的声音？"]这还听不明白？
[name="模糊的声音？"]后手就是后手，事情办砸的时候该做的事就叫后手。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#12$2",focus="m")]
[name="陈"]……什么……？  
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#12$2",focus="m")]
[name="陈"]你们……这是在说什么？  
[charslot(slot = "m", focus="n")]
[name="模糊的声音？"]国不可一日无君，少了一位真龙，那自然得再补上一位真龙。
[name="模糊的声音？"]父死子替，兄退弟进，几千年来都是这么传过来的。
[name="模糊的声音？"]要是别人都不在了，这女娃自然也是要去当真龙的。
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#6$2",focus="m")]
[name="陈"]……你们在胡说八道什么？！  
[dialog]
[avgdisplay(id = "1",style = "bg",name = "bg_black",afrom=0.6,ato=0,duration=1,slot = "bgover", layer = 1,block=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[avgdisplay(id = "1")]
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#4", focus="r",isblock=true)]
[name="太傅"]……  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#4", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……晖洁！  
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#11$2")]
[name="陈"]刚才的声音……  
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#12$2")]
[name="陈"]你们……都没听到？  
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#12$2")]
[name="陈"]……我……  
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#4", focus="r",isblock=true)]
[name="太傅"]魏公。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]我不苛求魏公在此刻想清万般利害。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]行事当三思，但时间毕竟紧迫。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]魏公，珍重。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……我送太傅一程。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_301_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="太傅"]不必。  
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_woodfloor_fts", volume=1)]
[dialog]
[charslot(slot = "r", afrom=1, ato=0, duration=1.5, isblock=true)]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……  
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_walk_n", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#1$2",posfrom="150,0",posto="80,0",duration=1,isblock=true)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#1$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]我不明白，那位太傅的意思。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#1$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]他特意让我留在这里，但我一点也听不明白你们所说的。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]晖洁……  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#11$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]什么叫炎国很有可能马上要大动干戈，却让你做好准备？  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#11$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]“不反”“巨兽”……你和这些事到底有什么联系？  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]晖洁。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]过去曾有许多错……有的是我亲自铸就，有的则是我无力阻止。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]我唯一在坚持的，是不让那些已经无力改变的错，祸及你们。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]只因我从不曾怀疑，你能做到的比我们更多。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#10$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]……别在这时候说这些。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#2", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]还有一事。  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#2", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]塔露拉……  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#2", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]告诉我，你上一次见到塔露拉，她还好吗？  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#1$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]不，我才不会在这个时候告诉你。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#1$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]如果你真的还在乎她，就不要在这种时候问她的事。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#13$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]文月姨不愿意见你永远当那个老顽固，她在意你的安危，我也不想——  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#13$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]……如果你真的还在乎除了你自己之外的谁，就不要把他们全都抛在身后。  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#13$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]告诉我，舅舅……  
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_1050_chen3_1#13$2", focus="r")]
[name="陈"]你到底准备做什么？  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#2", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]……  
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "char_2005_weiyw_1#5", focus="l")]
[name="魏彦吾"]听上去，她活得应当还好，至少不坏。
